entries.title: Terraformers

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with current patches and expansion availability.

primary.version: Current Windows PC release with expansion content
primary.why: Terraformers is a turn-based Mars colony-builder/resource-management game. Windows, macOS, Linux, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series, and Nintendo Switch releases exist, while Steam marks the 1.0 release as March 9, 2023 after April 2022 Early Access. The official site links Steam, GOG, Switch, Xbox, and PlayStation routes. Windows PC is the preferred archive route because it has the clearest current storefront, achievement, expansion, capture, and patch path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release and include the available gameplay expansion content before an archive run. Use console or other desktop versions only as convenience alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster split was found. First Steps on Mars is a demo/prologue-style entry, while later named releases should be treated as expansion content to verify before play.
